name: Council pattern (no people named)
description: The council as a pattern: those who look to the root dependency, the long cycle, and the accounting of wisdom, in the owner's words, which the owner says English does not quite fit. No specific tribe, nation or person is named in this record.

owner_words.text: Thé pattern of the council is what’s important, not the people.
It would be similar to an Oracle in AI terms i guess
Ones who looks to things at the Root dependancy, Long cycles, wisdom Accounting, or whatever other English terms dont quite fit

english_fit.statement: The owner's phrases are the primary text. The functions and the coordination block are readings of them and carry PROPOSED. If a reading and the owner's words differ, the words hold.

functions.reading: before a decision closes, trace what it rests on down the dependency chain, to the biosphere and physics, not only to the parties present
where_in_repo: audit D0-D5 dependency chain and crosswalk_D_L.json

functions.reading: weigh a decision against the cycles it will outlast, nested inside one another, with a declared horizon
functions.owner_context: earlier in this session the owner described cycles as named and nested, and said AI has its own cycles (wording as summarised, not verbatim)

functions.reading: keep an account of how decisions held up: what was reversed, what lasted, what was owed and completed; trust follows the account
where_in_repo: validation/example/council.json (repository example; description_source_status UNSOURCED): decision_reversal_rate (reversed or modified within 25 years)
ontology/social/stone_art_ledger.json (STONE_LEDGER: an obligation is recorded until it completes)

oracle_analogy.fits: the council is what the arena consults when its convergence map cannot settle what to do, and the arena acts on the answer
differs: authority is earned and can be lost, not given by construction
an answer can be objected to, and the objection becomes content
the answer carries a horizon of generations
the oracle is scored over time by the reversal account

coordination.carrier: A question that cannot be settled inside the cycle that raises it, carried with its map of agreement and disagreement (in AI terms, an arena convergence map).
coordination.signal: A proposed action whose consequences reach the root dependencies or outlast the cycle that proposes it. Objection is a signal: 'Objection is a form of teaching, not obstruction.'
coordination.record: The decision, held with the root dependencies it was traced to, the horizon it was weighed against, and the objections that taught it.
coordination.closure: 'the council does not close until the silence is comfortable.' A zero-sum outcome does not close: it is read as a scope error and the scope is widened toward the root dependency before deliberation continues.
coordination.trust_basis: Decisions that hold across long cycles. The account is kept by how many decisions are reversed or significantly modified within a generation; legitimacy is 'earned through demonstrated long-view reasoning, memory of precedent, and willingness to absorb short-term cost for long-term coherence.'

energy_cost.note: unmeasured. The cost the example file names is time and short-term cost absorbed for long-term coherence.

cycles.path: question with its map -> deliberation, objection read as teaching -> comfortable silence -> decision recorded with roots, horizon and objections -> consequences seen -> reversal or durability counted -> trust adjusted
outcome found zero-sum -> read as scope error -> scope widened toward the root dependency -> deliberation reopens
decision -> held across generations up to the horizon -> those who inherit the record review it against what came to pass

observer_cuts.cut: one meeting observed, answer taken as output (a one-shot oracle reading)
observer_cuts.note: no cycle closes inside the cut: the pattern reads as slow consensus, and the accounting and the horizon are invisible
the reversal count becomes visible; the horizon cycle does not close

observer_cuts.cut: followed across generations to the horizon

assumption_trace: a decision closes on a majority vote
authority comes from office or election
a decision is judged when it is made
disagreement is noise to be removed
one party's gain is another party's loss

complements.roles: the arena maps ('A session ends with a convergence map, not a verdict'); the council decides
complements.weld: the arena does not collapse disagreement into consensus; the council closes on comfortable silence. Neither protocol is changed; the hand-off is the weld.
